tibet_expedition_events.8 = { # Cross the border
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.8.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.8.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.8.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_military"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		var:tibet_expedition_progress_var >= 4

		NOR = {
			has_variable = delayed_expedition_events
			has_variable = entered_into_tibet
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = expedition_country
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = expedition_leader_var }
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
		set_variable = entered_into_tibet
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = c:TIB }
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_tibet_expedition }
			NOT = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = expedition_leader_var
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.8.a
		default_option = yes

		if = {
			limit = {
				c:TIB ?= {
					is_subject = yes
				}
			}
			c:TIB ?= {
				overlord = {
					trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.9 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			c:TIB ?= {
				trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.10 days = 1 }
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
			change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			c:TIB ?= {
				trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.11 days = 14 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.9 = { # Cross the border (Overlord alert)
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.9.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.9.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.9.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_military"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	immediate = {
		scope:expedition_leader = {
			owner = {
				save_scope_as = expedition_country
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:expedition_country }
			scope:expedition_country = {
				NOR = { has_journal_entry = je_tibet_expedition }
				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = expedition_leader_var
				}
			}
			NOT = { exists = c:TIB }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.9.a
		default_option = yes

		change_relations = {
			country = scope:expedition_country
			value = 5
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			add_liberty_desire = 5
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			c:TIB ?= {
				set_secret_goal = {
					country = ROOT
					secret_goal = antagonize
				}
			}
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.10 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.9.b

		# Diplomatically object

		change_relations = {
			country = scope:expedition_country
			value = -15
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = scope:expedition_country
				secret_goal = antagonize
			}
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.10 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.9.c

		# Reinforce Tibet!

		change_relations = {
			country = scope:expedition_country
			value = -30
		}

		add_modifier = {
			name = himalayan_affairs # temp hit to authority
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}

		scope:expedition_country = {
			create_incident = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 2
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = c:TIB
				secret_goal = dominate
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			c:TIB ?= {
				set_secret_goal = {
					country = ROOT
					secret_goal = befriend
				}
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = scope:expedition_country
				secret_goal = antagonize
			}
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			add_liberty_desire = -5
		}

		c:TIB ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_modifier = overlord_military_support }
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = overlord_military_support
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
			trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.10 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.11 = { # (Tibet) Block their advance?
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.11.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.11.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.11.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_military"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	immediate = {
		scope:expedition_leader = {
			owner = {
				save_scope_as = expedition_country
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_modifier = expedition_disturbs_the_people }  }
			save_scope_as = disturbed_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:expedition_leader }
			scope:expedition_leader = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_tibet_expedition }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.11.a
		default_option = yes

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_modifier = government_cowardice }
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
							has_trait = brave
							has_role = general
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = government_cowardice
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					NOT = { has_modifier = expedition_disturbs_the_people }
				}
			}
			scope:disturbed_state = {
				add_modifier = {
					name = expedition_disturbs_the_people
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.11.b

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_modifier = government_bravery }
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
							has_trait = brave
							has_role = general
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = government_bravery
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:expedition_country = {
			trigger_event = { id = tibet_expedition_events.12 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

		}

			text = tibet_expedition_delayed
			set_variable = {
				name = delayed_expedition_events
				months = 3
			}
		}
	}

		default_option = yes

		change_relations = {
			country = c:TIB
			value = 10
		}

		add_modifier = {
			name = tibetan_restitution
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_very_small
			days = short_modifier_time
		}

		random_list = {
			1 = { }
			1 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							ROOT.modifier:country_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 1
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:expedition_leader.modifier:character_expedition_events_explorer_mult > 0
						}
						add = 4
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = je_tibet_expedition_advance
					change_variable = { name = tibet_expedition_progress_var add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

### Phase 3: Negotiations with Tibet ###

tibet_expedition_events.20 = { # Who to address the ultimatum to?
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.20.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.20.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.20.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_ca_mountain_pass_military"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	trigger = {
		var:tibet_expedition_progress_var >= 6
		NOR = {
			has_variable = delayed_expedition_events
			has_variable = ultimatum_event
		}
		any_scope_character = {
			has_variable = expedition_leader_var
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				any_scope_character = {
					has_variable = expedition_leader_var
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				exists = c:TIB
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		c:TIB ?= {
			save_scope_as = tibet_scope
		}
		save_scope_as = expedition_country
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:TIB ?= {
					is_subject = yes
				}
			}
			c:TIB ?= {
				overlord = {
					save_scope_as = overlord_of_tibet
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = ultimatum_event
		random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = expedition_leader_var
			}
			save_scope_as = expedition_leader
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.20.a
		default_option = yes

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = sending_tibet_ultimatum_tt
			c:TIB ?= {
				trigger_event = {
					id = tibet_expedition_events.21
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = ultimatum_sent
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:overlord_of_tibet ?= {
						is_player = yes
					}
					c:TIB ?= {
						is_player = no
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.20.b # ISN'T THERE SOMEONE YOU FORGOT?
		trigger = {  # trigger tibet_expedition_events.22 only if overlord exists & c:TIB is subject (so this is not sent to an independent c:TIB with top_overlord)
			exists = scope:overlord_of_tibet
			c:TIB ?= {
				is_subject = yes
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = sending_tibet_overlord_ultimatum_tt
			scope:overlord_of_tibet = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = tibet_expedition_events.22
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = ultimatum_sent
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					scope:overlord_of_tibet ?= {
						is_player = no
					}
					c:TIB ?= {
						is_player = yes
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
		}
	}
}

tibet_expedition_events.21 = { # Ultimatum sent (Tibet)
	type = country_event
    placement = scope:current_expedition_location

    title = tibet_expedition_events.21.t
    desc = tibet_expedition_events.21.d
    flavor = tibet_expedition_events.21.f

    duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"

	immediate = {

		scope:expedition_leader = {
			owner = {
				save_scope_as = expedition_country
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:TIB ?= {
					is_subject = yes
				}
			}
			c:TIB ?= {
				overlord = {
					save_scope_as = overlord_of_tibet
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		NOT = { exists = scope:expedition_country }
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.21.a
		default_option = yes

		if = { # trigger tibet_expedition_events.26 only if overlord exists & c:TIB is subject (so this is not sent to an independent c:TIB with top_overlord)
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overlord_of_tibet
				c:TIB ?= {
					is_subject = yes
				}
			}
			scope:overlord_of_tibet = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = tibet_expedition_events.26 days = 1
				}
				set_variable = former_tibetan_overlord
			}
		}

		scope:expedition_country = {
			trigger_event = {
				id = tibet_expedition_events.27 days = 1
			}
		}

		hidden_effect = { # clearing out existing relations
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_subject = yes
				}
				make_independent = yes
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				country_rank <= rank_value:minor_power
				scope:expedition_country = {
					OR = {
						is_country_type = recognized
						is_country_type = colonial
					}
					country_rank >= rank_value:minor_power
				}
			}
			scope:expedition_country = {
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = c:TIB
					type = protectorate
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_rank <= rank_value:minor_power
				scope:expedition_country = {
					is_country_type = unrecognized
					country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_regional_power
				}
			}
			scope:expedition_country = {
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = c:TIB
					type = tributary
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:expedition_country = {
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = c:TIB
					type = vassal
				}
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					has_dlc_feature = lobbies
					any_political_lobby = {
						is_political_lobby_type = lobby_pro_country
						target = {
							scope:expedition_country = this
						}
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.21.b

		change_relations = {
			country = scope:expedition_country
			value = -40
		}
		scope:expedition_country = {
			set_variable = received_subjugation_refusal_var # variable for expedition_country to fail their Tibet Expedition JE if this option is selected
		}

		scope:expedition_country = {
			post_notification = tibet_refuses_demands
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_scope_character = {
						is_ruler = yes
						OR = {
							has_trait = ambitious
							has_trait = arrogant
							has_trait = imperious
						}
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					has_dlc_feature = lobbies
					any_political_lobby = {
						is_political_lobby_type = lobby_anti_country
						target = {
							scope:expedition_country = this
						}
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

	option = {

		hidden_effect = { # clearing out existing relations

					}

					make_independent = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = former_tibetan_overlord

			c:TIB ?= {

			}
		}

		if = {

				c:TIB ?= {

			scope:expedition_country = {

					country = c:TIB
					type = protectorate
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				c:TIB ?= {
					country_rank <= rank_value:minor_power
				}
				scope:expedition_country = {
					is_country_type = unrecognized
					country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_regional_power
				}
			}
			scope:expedition_country = {
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = c:TIB

				}

		else = {
			scope:expedition_country = {

					country = c:TIB
					type = vassal
				}
			}
		}

		scope:expedition_country = {
			trigger_event = {
				id = tibet_expedition_events.27
				days = 3
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tibet_expedition_events.22.b # Only the player should be able to get a last out like this, and only if it's not an MP where another player has been working hard at this themself
		trigger = {
			is_player = yes
			scope:expedition_country = { is_player = no }
		}

		scope:expedition_country = {
			create_incident = {
				country = ROOT
				value = 10
			}
		}
		scope:expedition_country = {
			post_notification = tibet_overlord_refuses_demands
		}
		scope:expedition_country = {
			set_variable = received_subjugation_refusal_var # variable for expedition_country to fail their Tibet Expedition JE if this option is selected by player
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = titanic

titanic.1 = { #you build the titanic
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:titanic_state

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_steam_ship"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	title = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					exists = c:GBR
					c:GBR = ROOT
				}
				desc = titanic.1.t
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { exists = c:GBR }
						NOT = { c:GBR = ROOT }
					}
				}
				desc = titanic.1.t2
			}
		}
	}
	desc = titanic.1.d
	flavor = titanic.1.f

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = built_the_titanic }
		has_technology_researched = radio
		any_scope_building = {
			is_building_type = building_shipyard
			has_active_production_method = pm_metal_shipbuilding #will need ironclad_tech to do this
		}
		OR = {
			any_interest_group = {
				is_in_government = yes
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_trait = ambitious
						has_trait = romantic
						has_trait = innovative
					}
				}
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				OR = {
					is_in_government = yes
					is_powerful = yes
				}
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				OR = {
					is_in_government = yes
					is_powerful = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_titanic_var
			}
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_olympic_var
			}
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_gigantic_var
			}
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_colosssal_var
			}
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_herculean_var
			}
			1 = {
				set_variable = custom_gargantuan_var
			}
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_shipyard
					#has_active_production_method = pm_metal_shipbuilding
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = titanic_state
			set_variable = titanic_state_var
			random_scope_building = {
				limit = {
					is_building_type = building_shipyard
					has_active_production_method = pm_metal_shipbuilding
				}
				save_scope_as = titanic_building
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = ambitious
							has_trait = romantic
							has_trait = innovative
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_trait = ambitious
							has_trait = romantic
							has_trait = innovative
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = titanic_ig
				set_variable = titanic_ig_var
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = titanic_leader
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
					OR = {
						is_in_government = yes
						is_powerful = yes
					}
					NOT = { has_variable = titanic_ig_var }
				}
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				save_scope_as = titanic_ig
				set_variable = titanic_ig_var
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = titanic_leader
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
					NOT = { has_variable = titanic_ig_var }
				}
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				save_scope_as = titanic_ig
				set_variable = titanic_ig_var
				leader = {
					save_scope_as = titanic_leader
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = titanic_ig_var }
				}
				save_scope_as = titanic_ig
				set_variable = titanic_ig_var
			}
		}
	}

	duration = 3

	option = { #focus on making it luxurious
		name = titanic.1.a
		default_option = yes
		set_global_variable = built_the_titanic
		add_modifier = {
			name = titanic_modifier
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				80 = {
					trigger_event = { id = titanic.2 days = 90 }
					#it's implied in the flavour text that the first event is about finishing the last touches, so getting this event later would probably make the player forget about it
				}
				20 = {
					trigger_event = { id = titanic.3 days = 90 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

    option = { #focus on making it more efficient
		name = titanic.1.b
		set_global_variable = built_the_titanic
		scope:titanic_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = titanic_building_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				80 = {
					trigger_event = { id = titanic.2 days = 90 }
				}
				20 = {
					trigger_event = { id = titanic.3 days = 90 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #dont
		name = titanic.1.c
		scope:titanic_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = no_titanic_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		scope:titanic_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = small_radicals
				pop_type = laborers #they may lose they job
			}
		}
		#rival company approves
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {	ig:ig_industrialists = scope:titanic_ig }
			}
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = rival_titanic_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {	ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = scope:titanic_ig }
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = rival_titanic_modifier
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			}

	}

	duration = 3

			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = trade_route_events

trade_route_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = trade_route_events.1.t
	desc = trade_route_events.1.d
	flavor = trade_route_events.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_fire.dds"

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			any_scope_state = { has_building = building_arms_industry }
		}
        any_market = {
            root.market = {
                market_imports_reliance = { target = prev goods = small_arms value > 0.25 }
            }
            "owner.relations(root)" <= 0
        }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_market = {
			limit = {
				root.market = {
                    market_imports_reliance = { target = prev goods = small_arms value > 0.25 }
                }
                "owner.relations(root)" <= 0
			}
			owner = {
                save_scope_as = arms_seller_threat
            }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trade_route_events.1.a
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_build_local_arms_industry
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trade_route_events.1.b
		default_option = yes
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_unreliable_weapon_imports
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

trade_route_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = trade_route_events.2.t
	desc = trade_route_events.2.d
	flavor = trade_route_events.2.f

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_engineer_blueprint"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
        any_market = {
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    root = { is_researching_technology = gunsmithing }
                    owner = { has_technology_researched = gunsmithing }
                }
                AND = {
                    root = { is_researching_technology = percussion_cap }
                    owner = { has_technology_researched = percussion_cap }
                }
                AND = {
                    root = { is_researching_technology = rifling }
                    owner = { has_technology_researched = rifling }
                }
                AND = {
                    root = { is_researching_technology = repeaters }
                    owner = { has_technology_researched = repeaters }
                }
                AND = {
                    root = { is_researching_technology = bolt_action_rifles }
                    owner = { has_technology_researched = bolt_action_rifles }
                }
            }
            root.market = {
                market_imports = { target = prev goods = small_arms value >= 5 }
            }
        }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_market = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
                    AND = {
                        root = { is_researching_technology = gunsmithing }
                        owner = { has_technology_researched = gunsmithing }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        root = { is_researching_technology = percussion_cap }
                        owner = { has_technology_researched = percussion_cap }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        root = { is_researching_technology = rifling }
                        owner = { has_technology_researched = rifling }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        root = { is_researching_technology = repeaters }
                        owner = { has_technology_researched = repeaters }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        root = { is_researching_technology = bolt_action_rifles }
                        owner = { has_technology_researched = bolt_action_rifles }
                    }
                }
                root.market = {
                    market_imports = { target = prev goods = small_arms value >= 5 }
                }
			}
            owner = {
                save_scope_as = arms_seller_gun_tech
            }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trade_route_events.2.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = modifier_researching_imported_weapons
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_small
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_researching_technology = gunsmithing }
			add_technology_progress = {
				technology = gunsmithing
				progress = 2500
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_researching_technology = percussion_cap }
			add_technology_progress = {
				technology = percussion_cap
				progress = 3500
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_researching_technology = rifling }
			add_technology_progress = {
				technology = rifling
				progress = 3500
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_researching_technology = repeaters }
			add_technology_progress = {
				technology = repeaters
				progress = 4150
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_researching_technology = bolt_action_rifles }
			add_technology_progress = {
				technology = bolt_action_rifles
				progress = 6000
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trade_route_events.2.b
		default_option = yes
	}
}

trade_route_events.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = trade_route_events.3.t
	desc = trade_route_events.3.d
	flavor = trade_route_events.3.f

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "asia_farmers_market"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_trade.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_interest_group = {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			OR = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
			}
		}
		capital.market = {
			owner = root
			mg:grain = { market_goods_pricier > 0.25 }
            market_imports_reliance = { goods = wine value >= 0.1 } # This event doesn't really have anything to do with reliance, but this makes sure it's a relevant amount.
            market_imports_reliance = { goods = luxury_clothes value >= 0.1 }
            market_imports_reliance = { goods = luxury_furniture value >= 0.1 }
		}
		NOT = {
			has_law = law_type:law_isolationism
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = angry_luxury_import_ig
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trade_route_events.3.a
		add_journal_entry = {
			type = je_set_up_grain_import
			target = scope:angry_luxury_import_ig
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trade_route_events.3.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:angry_luxury_import_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_refused_desired_imports
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

﻿namespace = trains

# Colliding for Sport
trains.1 = {
	type = country_event
	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_trains"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	title = trains.1.t
	desc = trains.1.d
	flavor = trains.1.f

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		has_technology_researched  = steel_railway_cars
		any_scope_state = {
			has_building = building_railway
		}
		any_interest_group = {
			is_revolutionary = no
			is_insurrectionary = no
			leader = {
				is_busy = no
				is_immortal = no
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_building = building_railway }
			save_scope_as = train_crashing_state
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				is_revolutionary = no
				is_insurrectionary = no # people who are angrily plotting doom in a smoky backroom will not make a happy public showing at a fair
				leader = {
					is_busy = no
					is_immortal = no
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = train_crash_attendee_ig
			leader = {
				save_scope_as = train_crash_attendee
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = trains.1.a
        default_option = yes
        scope:train_crash_attendee = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = a_smashing_appearance
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
        }
        random_list = {
        	90 = {
        		scope:train_crashing_state = {
		        	add_modifier = {
		        		name = the_desire_to_smash_things_up
						days = short_modifier_time
		        	}
	        	}
        	}
        	10 = {
        		scope:train_crash_attendee = { kill_character = yes }
		        scope:train_crashing_state = {
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = small_radicals # People get mad about the mishandled event
					}
		        }
        	}
        }
	}
	option = {
		name = trains.1.b
		scope:train_crash_attendee_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = the_desire_to_smash_things_up_has_been_denied
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
        random_list = {
        	90 = {
        		scope:train_crashing_state = {
		        	add_modifier = {
		        		name = the_desire_to_smash_things_up
						days = short_modifier_time
		        	}
	        	}
        	}
        	10 = {
		        scope:train_crashing_state = {
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = small_radicals # People get mad about the mishandled event
					}
		        }
        	}
        }
	}
}
﻿namespace = treaty_of_london_events

treaty_of_london_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = treaty_of_london_events.1.t
	desc = treaty_of_london_events.1.d
	flavor = treaty_of_london_events.1.f

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_aristocrats"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		c:NET ?= this
		NOT = {
			has_variable = treaty_of_london_initiation_var
		}
		year >= 1838
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = treaty_of_london_initiation_var
		c:BEL ?= {
			save_scope_as = belgium_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = treaty_of_london_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 95
		}
		c:BEL ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = treaty_of_london_events.2 popup = yes }
		}
		custom_tooltip = if_they_accept_tt
		custom_tooltip = treaty_of_london_explanation_tt
		show_as_tooltip = {
			add_journal_entry = {
				type = je_conference_of_london
			}
			c:BEL ?= {
				add_journal_entry = {
					type = je_conference_of_london
				}
			}
			every_country_in_europe = {
				limit = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
					NOR = {
						root ?= this
						c:BEL ?= this
					}
				}
				trigger_event = { id = treaty_of_london_events.3 popup = yes }
			}
		}
	}


	option = {
		name = treaty_of_london_events.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 5
		}
		c:BEL ?= {
			change_relations = { country = root value = -80 }
			create_diplomatic_catalyst = {
				type = catalyst_event_negative
				target = root
			}
		}
		every_country_in_europe = {
			limit = {
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				NOT = { this = root }
			}
			change_relations = { country = root value = -40 }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_secret_goal = {
				country = c:BEL
				secret_goal = conquer
			}
			c:BEL ?= {
				set_secret_goal = {
					country = c:LUX
					secret_goal = conquer
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
		}

treaty_of_london_events.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = treaty_of_london_events.4.t
	desc = treaty_of_london_events.4.d
	flavor = treaty_of_london_events.4.f

	cooldown = { days = normal_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "ep1_transfer_of_authority"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_default.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
	}

	immediate = {
		c:BEL ?= {
			save_scope_as = belgium_scope
		}
		c:NET ?= {
			save_scope_as = netherlands_scope
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = treaty_of_london_events.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 95
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:NET ?= this
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = treaty_of_london_outcome_tt
				enforce_treaty_of_london = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			show_as_tooltip = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = treaty_of_london_outcome_tt
					enforce_treaty_of_london = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					c:BEL ?= this
					c:NET ?= this
				}
				NOT = {
					any_scope_treaty = {
						binds = c:BEL
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = guarantee_independence
						}
					}
				}
			}
			create_treaty = {
				first_country = root
				second_country = c:BEL

				is_draft = no
				binding_period = { years = 5 }

				articles_to_create = {
					{
						article = guarantee_independence
						source_country = root
						target_country = c:BEL
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					c:BEL ?= this
					c:NET ?= this
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = guarantors_of_peace_modifier
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		show_as_tooltip = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_variable = favour_belgium_global_var
				}
				c:BEL ?= {
					take_on_scaled_debt = {
						who = c:NET
						value = c:NET.scaled_debt
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_variable = favour_netherlands_global_var
				}
				c:NET ?= {
					take_on_scaled_debt = {
						who = c:BEL
						value = c:BEL.scaled_debt
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		set_global_variable = tunguska_var

		}
	}

				is_in_government = yes
			}
		}

			name = tunguska_research
			days = short_modifier_time
		}
		s:STATE_UPPER_YENISEYSK = {
			add_devastation = 20
		}
	}
	option = { # it is an omen
		name = tunguska.1.c
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			ig:ig_devout ?= {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
		}
		ig:ig_devout ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = tunguska_omen
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		s:STATE_UPPER_YENISEYSK = {
			add_devastation = 20
		}
	}
	option = { # can we mine it?
		name = tunguska.1.d
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
				is_in_government = yes
			}
		}
		scope:tunguska_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = tunguska_mining
				days = short_modifier_time
			}
		}
		s:STATE_UPPER_YENISEYSK = {
			add_devastation = 20
		}
	}

# people use the urban centers to go full on Social Hour(tm)
urbanization_events.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:urbanization_state

	title = urbanization_events.2.t
	desc = urbanization_events.2.d
	flavor = urbanization_events.2.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_london_center"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = city_of_plenty_var }
		any_scope_state = {
			any_scope_building = {
				is_building_type = building_urban_center
				level >= 10 #London will get it at game start, but for everyone else this is quite hard
			}
			is_incorporated = yes
			any_scope_pop = {
				standard_of_living >= 32
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = city_of_plenty_var #won't hit the same city twice
		}
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_urban_center
					level >= 5
				}
				is_incorporated = yes
				any_scope_pop = {
					standard_of_living >= 32
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = urbanization_state
		}
	}

	cancellation_trigger = {
		scope:urbanization_state = {
			NOT = {
				any_scope_pop = {
					standard_of_living > 32
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #let them celebrate!
		name = urbanization_events.2.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:urbanization_state = {
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				strata = upper
				value = 0.1
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				strata = middle
				value = 0.1
			}
		}
	}

	option = { # party forever
		name = urbanization_events.2.b
		scope:urbanization_state = {
			add_modifier = { # rich people expect more parties
				name = luxurious_parties
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				strata = upper
				value = 0.25
			}
			add_loyalists_in_state = {
				strata = middle
				value = 0.25
			}
		}
	}
}

# Other IGs aren't happy that you're favouring the Industrialists
urbanization_events.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = urbanization_events.4.t
	desc = urbanization_events.4.d
	flavor = urbanization_events.4.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_factory_opening"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = industrialists_favouring_var }
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			OR = {
				is_in_government = yes
				is_powerful = yes
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = industrialists_favouring_var
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			save_scope_as = industrialist_ig
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists }
			}
			save_scope_as = opposing_ig
		}
	}

	option = { #appease them
		name = urbanization_events.4.a
		scope:opposing_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ig_happy_urbanization
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 2
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						c:FRA ?= this
						has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
					}
				}
				fra_favor_leader_ig_dynasty = yes
			}
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ig_happy_urbanization_bad
				days = normal_modifier_time
				multiplier = 2
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #ignore them
		name = urbanization_events.4.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:opposing_ig = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_ignored_ig_urbanization
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						c:FRA ?= this
						has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
					}
				}
				fra_disfavor_leader_ig_dynasty = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

urbanization_events.6 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:subsistence_state

	title = urbanization_events.6.t
	desc = urbanization_events.6.d
	flavor = urbanization_events.6.f

	duration = 3

	cooldown = { days = stupidly_long_modifier_time }

	event_image = {
		video = "votp_realist_household"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = subsistence_farms_var }
		any_scope_state = {
			is_incorporated = yes
			has_subsistence_building = yes
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			AND = {
				is_powerful = yes
				is_in_government = yes
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = subsistence_farms_var
			days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
		}
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_subsistence_building = yes
			}
			order_by = gdp
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = subsistence_state
		}
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			save_scope_as = industrialist_ig
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = urbanization_events.6.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:subsistence_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_factories_no_subsistence_farming
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ROOT = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_listened_to_advice
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = urbanization_events.6.b
		scope:subsistence_state = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_better_farms_no_subsistence_farming
				days = long_modifier_time

		}

	option = {

			add_modifier = {
				name = subsistence_farms_ignored
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
		ROOT = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = modifier_army_bases
				days = long_modifier_time
			}
		}
	}
}

utopian.2 = { # Utopians become either Communist, Anarchist, or Corporatist
	type = country_event

	title = utopian.2.t
	desc = utopian.2.d
	flavor = utopian.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_engineer_blueprint"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/invention_icons/realism.dds"

	cooldown = { days = very_long_modifier_time }

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		any_scope_character = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
		}
		has_technology_researched = anarchism
		has_technology_researched = socialism
		has_technology_researched = corporatism
		NOT = {
			has_variable = cruel_reality_var
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = cruel_reality_var
	}

	option = {
		name = utopian.2.a
		trigger = {
			any_scope_character = {
				NOT = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				}
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = non_pb_utopians_go_communist_tt
			every_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
					NOT = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					}
				}
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = pb_utopians_go_corporatist_tt
				every_scope_character = {
					limit = {
						ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
						is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					}
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
				}
			}
		}

	}

					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				}
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = non_pb_utopians_go_anarchist_tt
			every_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
					NOT = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					}
				}
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_character = {
					ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = pb_utopians_go_corporatist_tt
				every_scope_character = {
					limit = {
						ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
						is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					}
					set_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = no_more_utopians_tt
	}

	option = {
		name = utopian.2.c
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = utopians_go_corporatist_tt
			every_scope_character = {
				limit = {
					ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
				}
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = no_more_utopians_tt
	}

	option = {
		name = utopian.2.e
		custom_tooltip = utopians_stay_utopian_tt
		custom_tooltip = no_more_utopians_tt
	}
}

		}

					has_variable = var_warlord_three
				}
			}

			set_variable = var_warlord_four
		}
	}

			is_player = yes
		}

						owner = { has_variable = warlord_state }
					}
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = warlord_state
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						is_capital = no
						owner = ROOT
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = warlord_scope
				ROOT = {
					random_scope_state = {
						limit = {
							is_capital = no
							any_neighbouring_state = {
								scope:warlord_scope ?= owner
							}
						}
						set_state_owner = scope:warlord_scope
					}
				}
			}
		}
		change_tag = BEI
		set_global_variable = { name = chinese_central_government value = c:BEI }
		play_as = scope:scope_random_warlord_one
	}

warlord_china_events.301 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = warlord_china_events.301.t
	desc = warlord_china_events.301.d
	flavor = warlord_china_events.301.f

	cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }



	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid
	left_icon = scope:yan_xishan_thinker

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_journal_entry = je_reunify_china
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
		has_technology_researched = mass_propaganda
		NOT = {
			ruler = {
				interest_group = {
					OR = {
						has_modifier = yan_xishan_thought_mod
						has_modifier = failed_yan_xishan_thought_mod
					}
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			has_modifier = warlord_legitimacy
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = yan_xishan_thinker
			interest_group = {
				save_scope_as = yan_xishan_ig
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = warlord_china_events.301.a
		default_option = yes
		random_list = {
			50 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							any_scope_state = {
								is_production_method_active = {
									building_type = building_university
									production_method = pm_philosophy_department
								}
							}
						}
						add = 25
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							government_legitimacy > 75
						}
						add = 25
					}
				}
				root = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = yan_xishan_thought_mod
					}
				}
			}
			50 = {
				modifier = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							government_legitimacy < 50
						}
						add = 25
					}
				}
				root = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = failed_yan_xishan_thought_mod
						days = long_modifier_time
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = warlord_china_events.301.b
		add_modifier = {
			name = warlord_legitimacy
			days = long_modifier_time
		}
	}
}

# For OMA
zanzibar.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:sultanate_of_zanzibar_capital

	title = zanzibar.1.t
	desc = zanzibar.1.d
	flavor = zanzibar.1.f

	gui_window = event_window_1char_tabloid

	left_icon = scope:sultan_of_zanzibar

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	on_opened_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/Events/misc/1Character_Banner"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		# triggered by journal entry
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = muscat_and_oman
		ruler = {
			save_scope_as = sultan_of_muscat_and_oman
		}
		create_country = {
			tag = ZAN
			origin = ROOT
			state = s:STATE_ZANZIBAR.region_state:OMA
			on_created = {
		 		# We are creating the Busaidi Sultanate of Zanzibar — it was very much an Arab state up until the Zanzibar Revolution
		 		add_primary_culture = cu:bedouin
		 		remove_primary_culture = cu:swahili
				set_state_religion = rel:ibadi

				create_character = {
					template = zan_majid_bin_said # Sultan Majid of Zanzibar
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						game_date > 1837.1.1
					}
					create_character = {
						template = zan_barghash_bin_said # Barghash bin Said, younger brother of Majid
					}
				}
			}
		}
		c:ZAN ?= {
			save_scope_as = sultanate_of_zanzibar
			ruler = {
				save_scope_as = sultan_of_zanzibar
			}
	 		capital = {
	 			save_scope_as = sultanate_of_zanzibar_capital
	 		}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zanzibar.1.a
		custom_tooltip = zanzibar.1.a.tt
		default_option = yes

		# Cede East African holdings to Zanzibar
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_TANGANYIKA.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_TANGANYIKA.region_state:OMA = { set_state_owner = c:ZAN }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_LINDI.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_LINDI.region_state:OMA = { set_state_owner = c:ZAN }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_KENYA.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_KENYA.region_state:OMA = { set_state_owner = c:ZAN }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY.region_state:OMA = { set_state_owner = c:ZAN }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				num_subjects >= 1
			}
			every_direct_subject = {
				limit = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
				}
				c:ZAN ?= { transfer_subject = prev }
			}
		}

		c:ZAN ?= {
			# if Zanzibar would not immediately trigger the fail conditions of Lion of the Zanj, give it the Lion of the Zanj JE
			if = {
				limit = {
			    	NOR = {
			    		is_subject = yes
				        any_neighbouring_state = {
				        	state_region = {
								OR = {
									this = s:STATE_KENYA
									this = s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY
									this = s:STATE_ZANZIBAR
									this = s:STATE_TANGANYIKA
								}
							}
		        			OR = {
			        			owner = {
			        				is_not_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
			        			}
			        			owner = {
			        				is_subject = yes
			        				top_overlord = {
			        					is_not_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
			        				}
			        			}
		        			}
				        }
			        }
				}

				add_journal_entry = { type = je_lion_of_the_zanj }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zanzibar.1.b

		trigger = {
			is_player = yes # no point in this option for the AI
		}

		play_as = c:ZAN

		# Cede East African holdings to Zanzibar
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_TANGANYIKA.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_TANGANYIKA.region_state:OMA = { set_state_owner = c:ZAN }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_LINDI.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_LINDI.region_state:OMA = { set_state_owner = c:ZAN }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_KENYA.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_KENYA.region_state:OMA = { set_state_owner = c:ZAN }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY.region_state:OMA = { set_state_owner = c:ZAN }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				num_subjects >= 1
			}
			every_direct_subject = {
				limit = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
				}
				c:ZAN ?= { transfer_subject = prev }
			}
		}

		c:ZAN ?= {
			# if Zanzibar would not immediately trigger the fail conditions of Lion of the Zanj, give it the Lion of the Zanj JE
			if = {
				limit = {
			    	NOR = {
			    		is_subject = yes
				        any_neighbouring_state = {
				        	state_region = {
								OR = {
									this = s:STATE_KENYA
									this = s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY
									this = s:STATE_ZANZIBAR
									this = s:STATE_TANGANYIKA
								}
							}
		        			OR = {
			        			owner = {
			        				is_not_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
			        			}
			        			owner = {
			        				is_subject = yes
			        				top_overlord = {
			        					is_not_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
			        				}
			        			}
		        			}
				        }
			        }
				}

				add_journal_entry = { type = je_lion_of_the_zanj }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zanzibar.1.c

		custom_tooltip = zanzibar.1.a.tt

		# Don't cede East African holdings to Zanzibar, and start a fight

		s:STATE_ZANZIBAR = {
			add_claim = c:OMA
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_TANGANYIKA.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_TANGANYIKA = {
				add_claim = c:ZAN
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_LINDI.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_LINDI = {
				add_claim = c:ZAN
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_KENYA.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_KENYA = {
				add_claim = c:ZAN
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY.region_state:OMA
			}
			s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY = {
				add_claim = c:ZAN
			}
		}

		c:ZAN ?= {
			# if Zanzibar would not immediately trigger the fail conditions of Lion of the Zanj, give it the Lion of the Zanj JE
			if = {
				limit = {
			    	NOR = {
			    		is_subject = yes
				        any_neighbouring_state = {
				        	state_region = {
								OR = {
									this = s:STATE_KENYA

			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = {
						any_scope_state = {
							owner = {
								c:ZAN = this
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					state_region = {
						any_scope_state = {
							owner = {
								c:ZAN = this
							}
						}
					}
				}
				state_region = {
					save_scope_as = zanzibar_tanganyika_scope
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			c:ZAN.capital.state_region = {
				save_scope_as = zanzibar_tanganyika_scope
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				any_interest_group = {
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_colonial_resettlement
							value > neutral
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_colonial_exploitation
							value > neutral
						}
					}
					is_insurrectionary = no
					is_revolutionary = no
				}
			}
			random_interest_group = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_colonial_resettlement
							value > neutral
						}
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_colonial_exploitation
							value > neutral
						}
					}
					is_insurrectionary = no
					is_revolutionary = no
				}
				save_scope_as = sympathetic_to_colonialists_ig
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zanzibar.2.a  # let them do their thing
		default_option = yes

		# Consolidate ZAN with any potential ongoing civil wars, just to not think about that headache
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_diplomatic_play = {
					is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_revolution
					target = c:ZAN
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_revolutionary = yes
					is_diplomatic_play_enemy_of = c:ZAN
				}
				c:ZAN ?= {
					annex = prev
				}
			}
		}

		# Reduce Zanzibar in Zanzibar state down to the islands of Unguja and Pemba
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = s:STATE_ZANZIBAR.region_state:ZAN
			}

			# ZAN should keep:
			# xE020B0 - Unguja Island
			# x414325 - Pemba Island

			s:STATE_ZANZIBAR = {
				set_owner_of_provinces = {
					country = ROOT
					provinces = {
						x16F859 x438029 x6021AF x60A0AF x65FD48 x6B7D25 x7D05E3 x93DC46 xA06030 xA50F53 xE0D920 xE60324 xF87B77
					}
				}
			}
		}

		# if Zanzibar is a one-state state and doesn't have STATE_ZANZIBAR at all, just... let it die, man.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = s:STATE_ZANZIBAR.region_state:ZAN }
				c:ZAN ?= {
					is_ai = yes
					any_scope_state = {
						count = 1
					}
				}
			}
			annex = c:ZAN
		}

		# if Zanzibar has more than one state, regardless of whether it's a player or AI, and regardless of whether it's a subject or independent, mess it UP
		else_if = {
			limit = { c:ZAN ?= { any_scope_state = { count > 1 } } }
			c:ZAN ?= {
				# Cede Zanzibari holdings to ROOT in any state region where ROOT already has a presence
				every_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						is_capital = no
						state_region = {
							any_scope_state = {
								owner = ROOT
							}
						}
					}
					set_state_owner = ROOT
				}

				# Cede Zanzibari holdings to other colonial powers in any state region where ROOT does not have a presence
				every_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						is_capital = no
						state_region = {
							any_scope_state = {
								owner = {
									NOT = { ROOT = this }
									is_not_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
								}
							}
						}
					}
					state_region = {
						save_temporary_scope_as = ceded_state_region
					}
					region = {
						ordered_scope_country = {
							limit = {
								is_not_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
								any_scope_state = {
									state_region = {
										any_scope_state = {
											owner = c:ZAN
										}
									}
								}
							}
							order_by = country_rank
							position = 0
							check_range_bounds = no
							save_temporary_scope_as = highest_ranking_colonizer
						}
					}
					set_state_owner = scope:highest_ranking_colonizer

					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:highest_ranking_colonizer = {
								is_player = yes
							}
						}
						scope:highest_ranking_colonizer = {
							post_notification = zanzibar_2_player_notification
						}
					}
				}

				# Any Zanzibari states that are not the capital state and are not touched by outside colonizers become breakaway states

				every_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						is_capital = no
						state_region = {
							NOT = {
								any_scope_state = {
									owner = {
										is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					create_dynamic_country = {
						origin = c:ZAN
						country_type = unrecognized
						tier = principality
						culture = cu:swahili
						religion = rel:sunni
						capital = prev
					}
				}
			}
		}

		c:ZAN ?= {
			trigger_event = { id = zanzibar.3 }
		}

		hidden_effect = {
			# notify countries with an interest in Zanzibar's strategic region what's going on
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						is_country_type = decentralized
						ROOT = this
						c:ZAN ?= this
						AND = {
							any_scope_state = {
					        	OR = {
									state_region = s:STATE_KENYA
									state_region = s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY
									state_region = s:STATE_ZANZIBAR
									state_region = s:STATE_TANGANYIKA
									state_region = s:STATE_LINDI
								}
							}
						}
					}
					has_interest_marker_in_region = scope:zanzibar_strategic_region_scope # probably region_zanj 99% of the time
				}
				post_notification = zanzibar_2_notification
			}
		}

		### remember, you too experience politics
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_colonial_resettlement
						value > neutral
					}
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_colonial_exploitation
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				is_insurrectionary = no
				is_revolutionary = no
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_colonialists_pleased
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_interest_group = {
						OR = {
							law_stance = {
								law = law_type:law_colonial_resettlement
								value > neutral
							}
							law_stance = {
								law = law_type:law_colonial_exploitation
								value > neutral
							}
						}
						is_insurrectionary = no
						is_revolutionary = no
					}
				}
			}
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = ig_colonialists_pleased
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zanzibar.2.b  # hey buddy cut that out
		trigger = { is_player = yes } # why even bother giving this option to the AI

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_colonial_resettlement
						value > neutral
					}
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_colonial_exploitation
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				is_insurrectionary = no
				is_revolutionary = no
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_colonialists_displeased
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_interest_group = {
						OR = {
							law_stance = {
								law = law_type:law_colonial_resettlement
								value > neutral
							}
							law_stance = {
								law = law_type:law_colonial_exploitation
								value > neutral
							}
						}
						is_insurrectionary = no
						is_revolutionary = no
					}
				}
			}
			ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
				add_modifier = {
					name = ig_colonialists_displeased
					days = normal_modifier_time
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

zanzibar.3 = { # The Lion With No Pride
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = zanzibar.3.t
	desc = zanzibar.3.d
	flavor = zanzibar.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "southamerica_war_civilians"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	option = {
		name = zanzibar.3.a
		default_option = yes

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = zanzibar.3.tt
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = no
				any_subject_or_below = {
					NOT = { any_overlord_or_above = { NOT = { ROOT = this } } }
				}
			}
			every_subject_or_below = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { any_overlord_or_above = { NOT = { ROOT = this } } }
				}
				make_independent = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Heirs of Queen Aziza
zanzibar.4 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT

	title = zanzibar.4.t
	desc = zanzibar.4.d
	flavor = zanzibar.4.f

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_diplomats_negotiating"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_portrait.dds"

	duration = 3

	option = {
		name = zanzibar.4.a
		default_option = yes

		show_as_tooltip = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_RIFT_VALLEY } }
				s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY = {
					add_claim = ROOT
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_TANGANYIKA } }
				s:STATE_TANGANYIKA = {
					add_claim = ROOT
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_KENYA } }
				s:STATE_KENYA = {
					add_claim = ROOT
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_ZANZIBAR } }
				s:STATE_ZANZIBAR = {
					add_claim = ROOT
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_LINDI } }
				s:STATE_LINDI = {
					add_claim = ROOT
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					any_primary_culture = { cu:bedouin = this }
					owns_entire_state_region = STATE_RIFT_VALLEY
					owns_entire_state_region = STATE_TANGANYIKA
					owns_entire_state_region = STATE_KENYA
					owns_entire_state_region = STATE_ZANZIBAR
					owns_entire_state_region = STATE_LINDI
				}
				s:STATE_ZANZIBAR = {
					add_homeland = cu:bedouin
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_primary_culture = { cu:swahili = this }
					owns_entire_state_region = STATE_RIFT_VALLEY
					owns_entire_state_region = STATE_TANGANYIKA
					owns_entire_state_region = STATE_KENYA
					owns_entire_state_region = STATE_ZANZIBAR
					owns_entire_state_region = STATE_LINDI
				}
				s:STATE_RIFT_VALLEY = {
					add_homeland = cu:swahili
				}
				s:STATE_TANGANYIKA = {
					add_homeland = cu:swahili
				}
				s:STATE_LINDI = {
					add_homeland = cu:swahili
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Tippu Tip
zanzibar.5 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = zanzibar.5.t
	desc = zanzibar.5.d
	flavor = zanzibar.5.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_springtime_of_nations"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	trigger = {
		game_date > 1865.1.1
		game_date < 1890.1.1

		NOT = { has_global_variable = tippu_tip_appeared }

		# Zanzibar is doing a colonialism
		NOT = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_colonial_affairs
		}
		any_scope_state = {
			is_under_colonization = yes
		}

		# 'Lualaba' (actually Congo Orientale) should not be colonized by anyone yet
		s:STATE_CONGO_ORIENTALE = {
			NOT = {
				any_scope_state = {
					NOT = { owner = { is_country_type = decentralized } }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_global_variable = tippu_tip_appeared
		s:STATE_CONGO_ORIENTALE = {
			random_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						is_country_type = decentralized
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = tippu_tip_state
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zanzibar.5.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tippu_tip_country_spawn_tt
			create_country = {
				origin = ROOT
				tag = UTR
				state = scope:tippu_tip_state

				on_created = {
					activate_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					create_character = {
						template = zan_tippu_tip
						on_created = {
							set_character_as_ruler = yes
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							capital = {
								NOT = {
									any_scope_building = {
										is_building_type = building_barrack
										level > 2
									}
								}
							}
						}
						capital = {
							create_building={
								building="building_barrack"
								level=2
								reserves=1
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						OR = {
							has_trait = ambitious
							has_trait = reckless
						}
					}
				}
				add = -10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						OR = {
							has_trait = cautious
							has_trait = tactful
						}
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zanzibar.5.b
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tippu_tip_country_spawn_subject_tt
			create_country = {
				origin = ROOT
				tag = UTR
				state = scope:tippu_tip_state

				on_created = {
					activate_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					create_character = {
						template = zan_tippu_tip
						ruler = yes
					}
				}
			}

			ROOT = {
				create_diplomatic_pact = {
					country = c:UTR
					type = tributary
				}
			}
		}

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_abolitionists_mad
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		# nobody else liked this
		je:je_earn_recognition ?= {
			add_progress = { value = -50 name = earn_recognition_progress_bar }
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
					}
				}
				add = 5
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						OR = {
							has_trait = ambitious
							has_trait = reckless
						}
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						OR = {
							has_trait = cautious
							has_trait = tactful
						}
					}
				}
				add = -10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_interest_group ?= {
						leader = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
						}
					}
				}
				add = 5
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zanzibar.5.c

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tippu_tip_spawn_tt
			create_character = {
				template = zan_tippu_tip
				on_created = {
					add_character_role = agitator
					remove_character_role = general
					if = {
						limit = { c:ZAN ?= { NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned } } }
						set_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
					}
				}
			}
		}

		# nods of approval from the sidelines
		je:je_earn_recognition ?= {
			add_progress = { value = 10 name = earn_recognition_progress_bar }
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 0

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian_royalist
						}
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_interest_group ?= {
						leader = {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian_royalist
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add = 5
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zanzibar.5.dd
		highlighted_option = yes
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				ruler ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
				}
				any_interest_group = {
					is_in_government = yes
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver }
				}
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tippu_tip_general_tt
			create_character = {
				template = zan_tippu_tip
			}
		}

		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
				}
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = ig_abolitionists_mad
				days = normal_modifier_time
			}
		}

		# head-shakes of disapproval from the sidelines
		je:je_earn_recognition ?= {
			add_progress = { value = -10 name = earn_recognition_progress_bar }
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 0

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					any_interest_group ?= {
						leader = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
						}
					}
				}
				add = 5
			}
		}
	}
}

# The End of Arab Rule
zanzibar.6 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = zanzibar.6.t
	desc = zanzibar.6.d
	flavor = zanzibar.6.f

	duration = 3

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_springtime_of_nations"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	trigger = {
		# triggered by on_new_ruler on_action
	}

	immediate = {
		ruler ?= {
			save_scope_as = zan_ruler
			culture = {
				save_scope_as = zan_ruler_culture
			}
		}
		cu:swahili = {
			save_scope_as = zan_swahili_culture
		}
		cu:bedouin = {
			save_scope_as = zan_omani_culture
		}

		set_global_variable = decided_future_of_zanzibar
	}

	option = {
		name = zanzibar.6.a
		default_option = yes

		add_primary_culture = cu:swahili
		set_state_religion = rel:sunni
		remove_primary_culture = cu:bedouin

		add_radicals = {
			culture = cu:bedouin
			value = very_large_radicals
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zanzibar.6.b

		# Zanzibar remains an Arab state

		add_radicals = {
			culture = cu:swahili
			value = very_large_radicals
		}

		ai_chance = {
			base = 0

			modifier = {
				trigger = {
					ruler ?= {
						culture = {
							has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_middle_eastern
						}
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
		}
	}
}
